ruling: scope reviewer and operator 2026-10-26 under ADR-053 section 2 and Unified PR B design section 1 (DOC-DATE-2): a document's own date is a formal code only (the Official Journal header with its ELI act match, and the metadata properties dc:date, eli:date_publication, article:published_time); the English word triggers of DOC-DATE-1 are retired and a date stated in prose is the DIGEST-1 PR B reader's job with a verbatim quote. The document-date producer reads stored captures only (nothing is fetched, so no scrape cadence is exercised and rule 16 stands; the cadence_exception key only satisfies INV-RUN-1 for an apply propagate step that names a producer): it sets the dates the retired doc-date@1.0.0 wrote from a signature line or a header label back to NULL (all three columns together) and re-stamps the OJ and metadata dates doc-date@2.0.0
